libs.note:
BH-8262. The READY-QUEUE.log writer triage sessions call instead of a hand append: it writes ` size= kind= :: project=

` under the READY-QUEUE.log.lock sidecar lock and mirrors the ready row through rq_put. Read through lib_env_apply queue-line-put. Doc: docs/notes/2026-10-24-BH-8262-queue-line-put.md.

knobs.note: Seconds the writer waits for READY-QUEUE.log.lock (and for locks/harden-state.lock on a replace) before it gives up with rc 1 and writes nothing. 30 is the wait bin/queue-line-drop.sh uses on the same lock. A value that is not a whole number uses 30.
